race.comment: SINGING STAR (2) has been racing well without winning. Tackled a BM74 over this distance at Dubbo last start where she battled on well to hold fourth after racing up near the pace. Beautifully drawn and gets in nicely after the claim. Hasn't saluted for nearly a year but this is her chance. MIRAI SAN (3) is back after a four-month spell. Good fresh performer whose best form last prep was at 1200m, but while on the new side 1000m is not an issue. Not drawn the best but if he can get a trail he will be hard to hold out. ALTERCATION (5) flew home to just miss over this distance at Taree two back. Struggled at Gosford last start but this race is a better fit. GELSEY (6) returns from a 110-day break. Has a win and two placings from four first-up runs. No trials leading into this so the betting is going to tell the story. KAWATIRI (10) ran a cheeky race over this course and distance last time. Up in grade but should give backers a sight again.
